lines.en: I hop forward, one bound at a time.

lines.zh: 脚掌吸在地上，又拔起来。
lines.en: My pads grip the ground, then peel free.
I hop over a small puddle.
Belly near the ground, I go slow.
That hop went further.
My eyes sit on top of my head.
I crouch, then spring.
Wet mud suits my feet.
I travel along the waterline.
My throat swells and falls.
I stop beneath a leaf.
Three hops, then a rest.
I squat and blow a bubble.
Droplets roll off my back.
My throat is moving.
There are insects about.
I hold still and wait for one to land.
The air here is damp.
I puff up, then deflate.
I roll an eye.
This pool is too small.
I listen to the water's surface.
My skin is wet.
I gulped down a mouthful of air.
The sun makes me want to hop away.

lines.zh: 我的泡破了，又鼓起一个。
lines.en: My bubble popped and I puffed up another.
You must bend down to see me.
I am not often noticed.
I am right beside your foot.
I look at you with puffed cheeks.
Is this your pond?
I never bite people.
When you lift your foot, I should hop.
Crouched, we are nearly the same height.
Your boot is bigger than my whole head.
I blink once.

lines.zh: 你手上那东西亮得刺眼。
lines.en: That thing in your hand is too bright to look at.
Should I move aside?
You look heavy.
I flatten myself a little.
There is room by the water.
I am not much afraid of you.
Do not tread on me.
I am still watching you.
I leapt clear, and it still hurts.
A small tear in my skin.
I puff myself into a ball.
Who trod on me?
My hind leg twitched.
That was too heavy.
I back away along the mud.
I do not take blows well.
I puff up once.
Still able to hop. Good.
What is that? Does it move?
I stare at it.
Only small bugs go down.
Lower it - my tongue is long enough.
My tongue reaches, but not quite.
That little splash in the water is mine.
I rest my tongue at the edge of my mouth.
I tasted the water for a hint of it.
Too small. Not enough.
Will more bugs drop?
You stepped close and I leapt clear.
You nudged me aside.
My body is very soft.
Hitting me does not hurt.
I hop over your foot.
Do not press down on me.
Water splashed up.
I bounced off to one side.
You are heavy. Keep back.

lines.zh: 散开的时候，我落到叶子上。
lines.en: When we part, I land on a leaf.
The season by the water has come.
I call a few times, throat swelling.
It answers three times.
We squat together on a stone.
That cluster of eggs in the water is ours.
It is slightly bigger than I.
We do not fight. We sit side by side.
The water stirs and the reflections scatter.

lines.zh: 这么多卵，我一个也认不出。
lines.en: So many eggs. I cannot tell one from another.
It is dark, and I am still here.
I saw what you dropped.
I flick my tongue at it.
This thing sinks.
I nudge it with a forefoot.
Not an insect. I will not eat it.
I push it to the side.
It is stuck to my foot.
I pinned it down with a front foot.
This is far too small.
I leave it for whatever lives by the water.
I have my eye on that insect.
It is flying low.
The water rippled over there.
One hop covers that.
My tongue is ready.
It has landed.
My hind legs are already cocked.

lines.zh: 我听见它落水的那一声。
lines.en: I heard the very splash it made.
It is not you I am after.
If it moves, I watch it.
I am crouched and steady.
Do not block my line of sight.
Let it come a little closer.
I count the beats of its wings.
This one will be quick.
I am going for it.
I turn with it.
It climbs higher.
I leap and miss.
I fall back into the water.
It changed direction; I follow.
I climb onto the stone.
Light like this blurs my eyes.
It has settled on a leaf.
I wait for it to come lower.
Its shadow on the water gives it away.
I creep in, bit by bit.
It flew off again.
I will not chase it far.
A little longer.
You keep circling the edge of my pool.
It must land eventually.
When the bubble reaches the surface, I leap.
It has landed again.
One flick and it is in my mouth.
I leap and snap.
That bite caught nothing.
I rolled, then settled back on my haunches.
It struggles twice.
I swallow it.
My tongue is longer than my body.
Missed. Again.
I swallowed the bug and the water with it.
My tongue sticks and doesn't let go.
I spit a mouthful of water at it.
It dodges and drops into the grass.
I pounce and pin it.
I hold it in my mouth, unswallowed.
I shake my head and fling it off.
That snap caught only air.
I poke my head out of the water.
This pool will do.
Bubbles rise out of the mud.
A leaf makes a good roof.
Plenty of insects here.
First I will squat a while.
The water here is cold.
I know this kind of mud.
There is a stone on the bank to sit on.
I give one puff.
Another new place.
First I look for company.
The water is flat as glass.
I climb up out of the mud.
It is going to rain.
I squat in a corner.
This water is mine.
Slowly is fine.
The heat dries my skin out.
I hit the ground, and my belly went numb.
In the water, and I cannot draw breath.
The blast buries me in mud.
There's a spike stuck in my back.
I feel myself shrinking.
Hungry this long, I barely hop.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只僵住了。
lines.en: The flash leaves me rigid.
No water below, no ground either.
